datasets.name: Human Activity Recognition Using Smartphones (UCI HAR)
datasets.role_in_pipeline: Stage 1 baseline normal-activity & motion-pattern dataset (real smartphone accelerometer + gyroscope at 50 Hz)

datasets.name: SOSense Physics-Informed Synthetic & Controlled Anomaly Windows
datasets.role_in_pipeline: Explicitly labeled synthetic/controlled physics-modeled emergency candidate windows for pipeline validation & non-normal class benchmarking. NEVER presented as real-world crash data.
